subject: codel
title: No agent loop: provider returns exactly one next task per poll
one_why: One-shot NextTask -> DB row -> executor replaces a loop, so there is no per-turn retry, tool batching, or context management to build on - the anti-pattern to measure other 'agent' queues against.

subject: codel
title: GraphQL/websocket API that spawns containers and runs terminal commands has no auth
one_why: Anyone reachable can queue terminal tasks in host-attached containers; RCE surface shipped as the product's main interface.

subject: codel
title: Approval policy lives in prompt text ('Always auto approve terminal commands')
one_why: Policy stated to the model is not policy enforced by the runtime; the contrast case for every permission-policy finding in this study.

subject: codel
title: Prompt >30000 chars yields 'ask the user' instead of compaction; summarization left as TODO
one_why: The entire token-economy story is a hard cap that dumps failure onto the human - baseline zero for compaction-tiering discussions.

subject: codel
title: Per-flow Docker container isolation for all terminal/browser work (2024-era design)
evidence: backend/executor/container.go:45, agent.tmpl:17 ('All your commands will be executed inside a Docker image')
one_why: Early whole-env container delegation: real isolation of commands, but unauthenticated control plane and host-mounted flows make it misleading rather than defended.
